steps.description: Lines 1-4 define the `(name, pattern)` tuples for `"WHILE"`, `"PRINT"`, `"TRUE"`, and `"FALSE"`, where each keyword literal is followed by the negative lookahead `(?!\w)`.
Look at `(?!\w)` at the end of `r"while(?!\w)"` on line 1: it asserts that the character immediately after `while` is not a word character (`[A-Za-z0-9_]`), without consuming that next character.

steps.answer: `"or(x)"` matches `OR` because `'('` is not a word character (`\w`), whereas `"order"` fails `(?!\w)` because `'d'` is a word character, leaving `"order"` to match `IDENT`.
